access_continuity_justification: Two independently controlled maintainers can handle issues, changes, protected tags, and releases. The procedure and successful release dry run are recorded at https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/docs/CONTINUITY.md and https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/actions/runs/30125736952.
bus_factor_justification: The lead and continuity maintainers are different people with independent credentials and demonstrated release capability; see https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/docs/CONTINUITY.md.
repo_interim_justification: Public work-in-progress commits and reviewed pull requests are available at https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/commits/main and https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/pulls?q=is%3Apr.
version_unique_justification: Immutable versioned releases are published at https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/releases.
version_semver_justification: The project follows Semantic Versioning; see https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/docs/RELEASING.md.
release_notes_vulns_justification: Security fixes and advisory identifiers are recorded in https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md.
report_responses_justification: Response targets and channels are documented at https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/SUPPORT.md.
enhancement_responses_justification: Enhancement response targets and the public request process are documented at https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/SUPPORT.md.
report_archive_justification: GitHub Issues permanently archives public reports: https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/issues?q=is%3Aissue.
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: Private reporting is enabled at https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/security/advisories/new and documented at https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/security/policy.
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: Acknowledgment, assessment, remediation, and disclosure targets are documented at https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/security/policy.
build_floss_tools_justification: The build uses the FLOSS Go toolchain, Make, and shell scripts; see https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/Makefile.
test_justification: Automated unit, integration, race, cloud-consumer, and fuzz tests are maintained in the repository and described at https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/docs/QUALITY.md.
test_invocation_justification: Run the complete suite with make ci-full; see https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/Makefile.
test_most_justification: CI enforces at least 90% statement coverage across all non-example shipping code, including the CLI; see https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/scripts/check-statement-coverage.sh.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: Tests run on every pull request and main push: https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/actions/workflows/ci.yaml.
test_policy_justification: All new behavior and bug fixes require tests under https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md.
tests_are_added_justification: The contribution and quality policies require tests for every new behavior: https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/docs/QUALITY.md.
tests_documented_added_justification: Testing requirements and commands are documented at https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md.
warnings_justification: gofmt, go vet, golangci-lint, and CodeQL run in CI: https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yaml.
warnings_fixed_justification: The quality policy requires analyzer findings to be fixed or narrowly justified: https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/docs/QUALITY.md.
warnings_strict_justification: Analyzer and formatting failures block the required CI gate: https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yaml.
know_secure_design_justification: Security design, trust boundaries, requirements, and mitigations are documented at https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/docs/SECURITY_REVIEW.md and https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/security/policy.
know_common_errors_justification: CodeQL, Govulncheck, OSV Scanner, Gitleaks, fuzzing, race tests, and review controls are documented at https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/docs/QUALITY.md.
crypto_published_justification: Confii implements no cryptographic algorithms; transport and authentication cryptography are delegated to the Go standard library and maintained provider SDKs as documented at https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/docs/SECURITY_REVIEW.md.
crypto_call_justification: TLS and provider authentication use the Go standard library and maintained provider SDKs; no custom primitive is called directly.
crypto_floss_justification: The Go standard library and cloud/Vault SDK dependencies used for transport and authentication are FLOSS and declared in Go module manifests.
crypto_keylength_justification: Confii does not generate or select cryptographic keys; provider and TLS implementations own key selection.
crypto_working_justification: Supported Go and provider security implementations are kept current by dependency automation and vulnerability gates documented at https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/docs/QUALITY.md.
crypto_weaknesses_justification: Govulncheck, OSV Scanner, CodeQL, and dependency review continuously check the used cryptographic dependencies and call paths.
crypto_pfs_justification: Confii does not operate a TLS server or select server cipher suites; callers and remote providers own endpoint TLS policy.
crypto_password_storage_justification: Confii does not implement password authentication or store password verifiers.
crypto_random_justification: Confii does not generate cryptographic random values or keys.
delivery_unsigned_justification: Releases include checksums and signed GitHub attestations; see https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/docs/RELEASING.md.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: The 60-day maximum and faster normal target are documented at https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/security/policy; recent dependency advisories were remediated immediately.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: Confirmed critical vulnerabilities block releases under https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/security/policy.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: Gitleaks scans every pull request and release tree in https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yaml.
static_analysis_justification: go vet, golangci-lint, and CodeQL run on every pull request; see https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yaml and https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yaml.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL security-extended analysis, Govulncheck, and OSV Scanner check common vulnerabilities and vulnerable dependencies.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: Static-analysis failures block merge and findings are fixed or narrowly documented under https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/docs/QUALITY.md.
static_analysis_often_justification: Static analysis runs for every pull request, main push, and scheduled CodeQL scan.
dynamic_analysis_justification: Native Go fuzzing, race detection, integration tests, and cloud-consumer tests run routinely in https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yaml.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: Production code is Go, a memory-safe language; CGO is disabled for release binaries. Race detection and fuzzing are still run.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: Confirmed dynamic-analysis failures block merge and require regression coverage under https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/docs/QUALITY.md.
dco_justification: The DCO and required Signed-off-by process are documented at https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md.
documentation_current_justification: Documentation is versioned with code, built strictly on changes, and reviewed in pull requests.
accessibility_best_practices_justificati: Confii is a Go library and developer CLI without a project-produced graphical user interface; its documentation uses the accessible MkDocs Material theme.
internationalization_justification: Confii is a locale-neutral Go API and developer CLI; it does not produce a localized end-user interface.
sites_password_security_justification: The project website is static and has no project-operated password authentication.
maintenance_or_update_justification: Supported release lines and update expectations are documented at https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/security/policy.
vulnerability_report_credit_justificatio: Reporter recognition policy is documented at https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/security/policy.
coding_standards_enforced_justification: Formatting, vet, lint, CodeQL, tests, and review by an eligible collaborator other than the last pusher are required before merge.
build_standard_variables_justification: The standard Go build honors GOOS, GOARCH, GOFLAGS, GOCACHE, and GOMODCACHE; see https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/docs/QUALITY.md.
build_preserve_debug_justification: Normal make build uses go build without stripping debug information; stripped release builds are a separate explicit workflow.
build_non_recursive_justification: The Go build graph and top-level Make targets are non-recursive; nested modules are verified explicitly.
build_repeatable_justification: Pinned module manifests and make reproducible-build-check provide repeatable declared-input builds.
installation_common_justification: Users install with the standard go get/go install mechanisms documented at https://confii-go-docs.pages.dev/installation/.
installation_standard_variables_justific: Standard Go installation honors GOPATH and GOBIN.
installation_development_quick_justifica: make deps followed by make ci provides a documented development setup at https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md.
external_dependencies_justification: Every dependency and checksum is declared in https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/go.mod, the nested module manifests, and docs/requirements.txt.
dependency_monitoring_justification: Dependabot, dependency review, Govulncheck, OSV Scanner, and module verification are documented at https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/docs/QUALITY.md.
updateable_reused_components_justificati: Dependencies are standard versioned Go modules updated through reviewed manifest changes.
interfaces_current_justification: Supported Go versions and provider SDKs are tested in CI and dependency updates are automated.
automated_integration_testing_justificat: Integration and isolated cloud-consumer suites run on every pull request.
regression_tests_added50_justification: The project requires regression tests for every bug fix unless technically impossible, exceeding the 50% criterion.
test_statement_coverage80_justification: CI enforces at least 90% statement coverage across all non-example shipping code, including the CLI.
test_policy_mandated_justification: Branch protection, required CI, the PR template, and code-owner review enforce the testing policy.
implement_secure_design_justification: The threat model and dated assurance review map security requirements to implementation and tests: https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/docs/SECURITY_REVIEW.md.
crypto_algorithm_agility_justification: Confii implements no cryptographic protocol or algorithm selection; supported Go/provider TLS stacks own negotiation.
crypto_credential_agility_justification: Cloud and Vault integrations use provider credential chains and short-lived identity methods without hard-coded credentials.
crypto_used_network_justification: Remote HTTP, cloud, Vault, GitHub, and module distribution paths use TLS.
crypto_tls12_justification: Supported Go releases use modern TLS defaults, and all project-operated distribution endpoints require HTTPS.
crypto_certificate_verification_justific: Confii uses Go and provider default certificate verification and exposes no insecure-skip-verify self-config option.
crypto_verification_private_justificatio: No private PKI bypass is implemented; callers that provide trusted roots remain responsible for their private trust configuration.
signed_releases_justification: Tags are signed and release archives receive signed GitHub provenance; see https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/docs/RELEASING.md.
version_tags_signed_justification: The release process requires signed annotated root and nested-module tags.
input_validation_justification: Parser, selector, traversal, schema, environment, and provider inputs have negative tests and documented security requirements.
hardening_justification: Memory-safe Go, CGO-disabled releases, race tests, fuzzing, -trimpath release builds, least-privilege workflows, and protected branches are documented at https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/docs/SECURITY_REVIEW.md.
copyright_per_file_justification: Every Go and shell source file carries a Confii Contributors copyright statement.
license_per_file_justification: Every Go and shell source file carries SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT; build and workflow sources use the same SPDX declaration.
repo_distributed_justification: The authoritative repository uses distributed Git: https://github.com/confiify/confii-go.
small_tasks_justification: Bounded newcomer tasks are maintained at https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/issues?q=is%3Aopen+label%3A%22good+first+issue%22.
contributors_unassociated_justification: The public record does not yet establish two unassociated significant contributors. Progress and acceptance requirements are documented at https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/docs/OPENSSF_BEST_PRACTICES.md.
require_2FA_justification: GitHub's mandatory 2FA program requires code contributors to enroll, covering repository changes and sensitive GitHub security data: https://docs.github.com/en/authentication/securing-your-account-with-two-factor-authentication-2fa/about-mandatory-two-factor-authentication.
secure_2FA_justification: The people controlling every privileged maintainer account confirmed use of authenticator-application cryptographic 2FA and no reliance on SMS-only 2FA. The dated assurance and maintainer roster are documented at https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/docs/CONTINUITY.md and https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md.
two_person_review_justification: The 2026-07-25 ledger records 5 qualifying independently reviewed PRs among 19 non-trivial merged PRs. The evidence, measurement, and forward policy are documented at https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/docs/OPENSSF_BEST_PRACTICES.md.
test_branch_coverage80_justification: CI uses the BSD-licensed Gobco v1.3.4 tool and enforces at least 80% aggregate condition/branch coverage across every non-example shipping package: https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/scripts/check-branch-coverage.sh.
hardened_site_justification: The production documentation site at https://confii-go-docs.pages.dev/ was verified on 2026-07-25 to return nonpermissive Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Strict-Transport-Security, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy headers. The deployable policy and repeatable live test are documented at https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/docs/HOSTING.md.
security_review_justification: The 2026 security review covers requirements, boundaries, methods, findings, and residual risks at https://github.com/confiify/confii-go/blob/main/docs/SECURITY_REVIEW.md.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Go has no build mode that disables language assertions; test, race, and fuzz checks execute their failure checks in CI.
